425:t_2:74.en:
$n
「Are you already done with the debriefing?」

425:t_2:75.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Yeah... There's only so much I can tell them.」

425:t_2:76.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「They said I could see $n for a little while.」

425:t_2:78.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「The military people told me why you're here, $n.」

425:t_2:79.en:
$n
「...I'm sorry... I was sort of deceiving you...」

425:t_2:80.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「It's okay. Everyone has a few secrets.」

425:t_2:81.en:
$n
「Why are you here, $$マキ#pilot$$...? And $$シンヤ#pilot$$ and $$ミサコ#pilot$$, too...」

425:t_2:82.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I'll tell you from the beginning...」

425:t_2:83.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Around February this year... I quit the hospital.」

425:t_2:84.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I had various reasons, but the biggest was that I thought I could do something for someone else as a nurse, too...」

425:t_2:85.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「So I... volunteered as a nurse on the battlefield.」

425:t_2:87.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「It's the same as you hiding from me that you were fighting, $n.」

425:t_2:89.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I thought you were just an ordinary high school student, $n... so I couldn't tell you I was going to a battlefield...」

425:t_2:90.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I knew it was a terrible thing to do, $n, but I figured that someday you'd forget about me and go on with your own life, $n...」

425:t_2:92.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「After that, I was at a field hospital in Central Asia when the Empire's manhunt got me.」

425:t_2:93.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「...I don't really want to remember what happened after that, but after all sorts of tests, I was brought to this Earth...」

425:t_2:95.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I don't really know... They made me shout, forced me through brutal exercise, and sometimes even did things like torture...」

425:t_2:97.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「But it's all right. See, I'm still alive.」

425:t_2:99.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「...After I was brought here, the people around me were taken away somewhere, one by one...」

425:t_2:100.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Those people would come back after about a month... But when they did...」

425:t_2:102.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Yeah... ...I met $$シンヤ#pilot$$ and $$ミサコ#pilot$$ here, too.」

425:t_2:103.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「They were already like that when I met them, though...」

425:t_2:106.en:
$n
「You're safe now, $$マキ#pilot$$. Nothing frightening will happen to you anymore.」

425:t_2:107.en:
$n
「We'll protect you and the others, $$マキ#pilot$$.」

425:t_2:108.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「There... I kind of wish you'd said, 'I'll protect you, $$マキ#pilot$$.'」

425:t_2:111.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「When we first met, you seemed somehow reckless, and sometimes sad, so I couldn't take my eyes off you, but...」

425:t_2:112.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Now you seem to have a strength that nothing can beat.」

425:t_2:115.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I do take some pride in having been a help to you, too. But you became strong through your own power, $n.」

425:t_2:116.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Or was there someone besides me who supported your heart, $n?」

425:t_2:118.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Why don't you make it clear, $n?」

425:t_2:122.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I'm only a candidate for now, though...」

425:t_2:124.en:
$$ティティ$$
「But I won't lose to some ex-girlfriend.」

425:t_2:125.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Is she the one who supported you, $n?」

425:t_2:128.en:
$$ティティ$$
「This... does this mean the enemy is coming...?」

425:t_2:129.en:
$n
「$$ティティ$$... Look after $$マキ#pilot$$ for me.」

425:t_3:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why, $$ジェフリー$$... All of you are here together, too.」

425:t_3:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Until today, I have treated you as a fellow comrade, a member of $c.」

425:t_3:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But you've been keeping secrets from us. You're going to tell us everything.」

425:t_3:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Understood. I will issue a code to lift part of my confidentiality obligation.」

425:t_3:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Normally, this would be a prohibited matter for a $$ＤＥＭ$$ employee...」

425:t_3:12.en:
$n
「Spare me the speeches. Choose, right now.」

425:t_3:13.en:
$n
「Will you keep being an agent robot for $$ＤＥＭ$$, which never even contacts you, or fight alongside us as a member of $c...? Which is it?」
